svg.text: T H E B L A C K L E D G E R
1957 Cadillac Eldorado · Adeline Marchetti — contestant vehicle dossier
Beautiful at 20 ft — rotted, mildewed up close
pink with heavy chrome trim and tail fins, an
ornate hood ornament shaped like a young woman,
pristine from afar but rotted and mildewed up
Realistic · Symmetry On · Quad · ~45k tris · PBR 4K
